answer: Each agent identity is bound to a proof-of-work stake whose registration entry is a named cedar log line in a public ledger, and every new identity must burn a fee of 0.5% of its declared stake plus wait eight epochs before voting. An attacker creating N identities pays 0.5% of stake N times and locks each full stake in escrow; voting weight is capped at the stake amount, so splitting one wallet into many changes nothing because a juniper-certified weight audit recomputes total stake across all linked keys and slashes 30% of any cluster exceeding its certified timber budget.
